# Round 4: findings and remaining limits

Research cut-off: November 4, 2026. Subject: Michael Edward Bleich, CRD 4262671.

This pass adds official historical adviser records and narrows several identity questions. It does not complete the subject's full employment history, establish his alleged Inferent affiliation, or provide comprehensive court clearance. Parallel Search supplied discovery leads; retained regulator and court originals support the findings. Independent specialists investigated the bounded tracks and separate reviewers checked the sources and consolidated index.

## What changed

The May 2009 owner date belongs to MEB INC, not to Ophir employment. EMP5-C03. |

## EntryPoint withdrawal: preserve the actual attribution

The December 10, 2021 ADV-W, FilingID 1583338, reports a full withdrawal and says the newly formed adviser using the 120-day route failed the eligibility criteria for continued registration. It also says Business Ceased=N. This is the firm's filed explanation. It is an administrative withdrawal record, not a disciplinary adjudication, personal sanction or business-closure finding.

The May 12, 2022 ERA reports a legal/business-name update to ENTRYPOINT CAPITAL, LLC. The LLC name already appears in the December 2021 withdrawal. The reporting update cannot independently date a corporate name change.

## Historical ownership and financial observations

The March 2023-June 2024 EntryPoint disclosures identify United Master Investment 2, LLC; United Master, LLC; United International Bank Corp; and a disclosed trust/trustee chain. Each edge retains the filed capacity and ownership band. No similarly named bank has been joined to that chain. A trustee role has no inferred numerical ownership.

EntryPoint's specific ERA private-fund-assets field reports $30 million in May 2022, $32 million in the 2023 snapshots, and $208,336,695 in March 2024. These are distinct from later RAUM and fund gross assets; filing dates are not verified measurement dates.

Inferent's withdrawal schedule reports assets of $1,261,506 and liabilities plus equity of $1,261,505. The one-dollar mismatch and reported equity of negative $293,731 are retained unchanged. The balance-sheet measurement date is unknown. These are conditional-branch adviser-company observations, not Bleich's finances or a legal insolvency conclusion.

The previously verified latest EntryPoint RAUM observation remains $999,157,153, measured September 30, 2026, in the October 15, 2026 ADV. This round does not replace that observation with the earlier ERA figures.

The normalized package contains 396 captured source representations, 247 source-linked assertions, 37 entity entries, 67 financial observations and 342 search-log entries. These include candidates, derived extracts and access records, not just unique verified filings. The nine events comprise five firm regulatory matters, one arbitration and three administrative withdrawal filings. None of the withdrawals is classified as a sanction.

Original compressed SEC archive members are retained with reconstruction metadata, CRC32 and SHA256 checks. Expanded target extracts are derivatives. Claims use exact CRD/FilingID joins and source-specific locators. In the employment packet, CSV ordinals exclude the header; in the withdrawal packet they include it. Use the convention stated in each locator.

Legacy repository files and the unavailable Library documents were not used. Personal civil proceedings are excluded. No account, purchase, contact, NYSCEF attempt or default-branch merge was made. The evidence remains on the existing research branch.

# Remaining work: instructions for the diligence team

Status after the November 4, 2026 research pass. This is a separate acquisition and verification queue, not a list of allegations and not a claim that the missing records do not exist. The completed public-source searches are documented in the evidence index.

Use the preserved originals first. Do not repeat an unsuccessful endpoint or completed full-file scan unless access changes, new data appears, or a specific discrepancy requires it. For every new record preserve its original bytes, URL, retrieval time in UTC, SHA256, filing/accession/docket identifier, date basis, physical PDF page and claim link. Keep source statements, allegations, findings, inferences and unresolved questions separate.

## 1. Establish the early employment chronology

Obtain an original historical Form U4 employment-history section, an accessible official CRD history for individual **4262671**, or an authenticated employer record contained in an official public filing. Prioritize the alleged Chase, Lehman and Barclays intervals and any 2000 filing or 2008 transfer.

The firm reports establish identity and later roles. The Lehman RSU schedule establishes a named contractual entry, with the person-to-CRD join still provisional. Neither supplies the missing employment intervals. Employer websites and third-party biographies may locate records but remain leads under the approved evidence standard.

**Completion test:** an original explicitly identifies the subject and supplies the role and date precision. Record employment dates separately from registration and ownership-status dates. If the needed history requires restricted CRD access or a request to an institution, leave the gap pending authorized access.

## 2. Resolve the alleged Inferent affiliation and any Ophir transaction

Locate a dated regulator-hosted individual disclosure, original brochure supplement, publicly filed professional agreement or other official public record explicitly connecting Bleich to Inferent. Separately seek an executed transaction or succession instrument for any alleged Ophir transfer.

The six Inferent owner/executive filings contain no subject match; they are not employee rosters. Exact Marques/Pak overlap between Inferent and EntryPoint is not a substitute for direct evidence of a Bleich role or a transaction.

**Completion test:** a defensible identity link, express role or transaction language, precise dates, and original page/field support. Otherwise keep Inferent conditional and any merger or asset-transfer proposition unresolved.

## 3. Complete adviser registration and post-withdrawal history

For **EntryPoint CRD 313946**, obtain the complete 2021 application/approval and withdrawal correspondence under **801-122062**, the initial ERA record under **802-125863**, and the 2024 application/receipt/approval sequence under **801-130798**. Use ADV-W **1583338** and transition FilingID **1869875** as anchors.

For **Inferent CRD 292027**, obtain the actual exemption basis and later official operating/reporting history after ADV-W **1398407**, filed March 21, 2020. For **Ophir CRD 164729**, use ADV-W **1123733** and obtain any subsequent transfer or dissolution instrument only if needed to answer a distinct corporate question.

**Completion test:** distinguish submission, receipt, execution, effective registration, asset measurement, business cessation and legal dissolution. The dual final-ERA/initial-registration flags are already procedurally explained; do not reopen that narrow issue without new evidence. No compliance or deadline conclusion follows from dates alone.

## 4. Obtain MEB originals and an owner-to-identifier bridge

Request or locate freely available originals for **MEB NY INC., New York DOS 3772241**:
- Incorporation: **film 090206000693, February 6, 2009**.
- Certificate of Change: **film 090925000007, September 25, 2009**.

The electronic dataset codes the latter as a process-address change. It is not a name-change certificate or a formal current-status certificate. To connect **MEB INC** and **MEB NY INC**, require an explicit same-identifier name-change, continuation or other legal bridge. To connect DOS 3772241 to the disclosed ownership chain, require an original carrying both a strong entity identifier and the professional relationship.

**Completion test:** separate legal identity, name history and ownership proof. A common name, signer, incorporator or process recipient alone is insufficient. The official copy-order route is documented; no order, fee or account was authorized or placed.

## 5. Resolve the remaining corporate identifiers and historical ownership changes

Prioritize owner-linked originals for **Finch LLC candidate Delaware 5142327**, **NAYS LLC candidate 4688408**, **EntryPoint GP LLC candidate 3458887**, **EntryPoint Partners LP candidate 3458856**, and **EP Fund GP LLC** whose formation identifier remains unresolved. Keep EntryPoint GP and EP Fund GP separate. Do not reuse excluded Finch 10521968 or rejected CIK 1977777.

Obtain legal identifiers/jurisdictions for **United Master Investment 2, LLC**, **United Master, LLC**, and **United International Bank Corp** before searching their exact registries. The similar GLEIF bank candidate remains unjoined.

For the Scout/Ophir ownership transitions, seek a public original ownership or transaction instrument reconciling Scout's June 1 versus August 31, 2012 observations and Ophir's March versus June 2016 ownership-band snapshots. If financing is material, identify the unnamed remaining Scout lender from an original agreement.

**Completion test:** a unique-identifier bridge plus the specific relationship. Formation records alone may not name owners. Disclosure differences and status-acquired fields do not establish transaction dates, consideration, economic exit or exact present stakes.

## 6. Close targeted litigation follow-up when a new official lead is available

For **Scout Trading LLC v Wedbush Securities, FINRA 15-02816**, seek an original confirmation, vacatur, appeal or satisfaction record. Match the parties, arbitration identifier, November 2016 award and $237,594 damages before joining a docket. Exclude the unrelated AC Scout/Newedge matter.

Use accessible official court opinions, GovInfo and regulator repositories. An authenticated court-stamped mirror can be a lead, but provenance and target identity must be established before promotion under the official-record standard. Expand NFA/state native search coverage only where freely accessible and relevant.

**Completion test:** original case identifier, procedural role, dates and disposition. An award or confirmation order is not proof of payment. Do not calculate collected interest without the controlling dates and payment evidence.

## 7. Preserve court and registry access gaps explicitly

- **NYSCEF:** accepted access gap. Do not retry, ask for CAPTCHA assistance or imply clearance without a new explicit instruction.
- **PACER:** no authorized account is available. Agents can use free official sources but cannot supply credentials or complete an account-only search. Any later account/paid access needs separate authorization.
- **New York Law Reporting Bureau native search:** its separate public interface returned a JavaScript/cookie access challenge. No query result was obtained. A future ordinary public-access route may be used if available; stop at any human check.
- **CourtListener and selected official archives:** retain their recorded failures as access limitations, not negative findings.
- **Paid/certified corporate copies:** no order was placed. If indispensable, have the authorized team obtain the exact instruments identified above and preserve provenance.

These limits prevent a comprehensive court or regulatory clearance. The completed CFTC content-index queries and indexed federal/state searches are bounded coverage only.

## 8. Obtain the outstanding brochure and offshore originals

Locate **Ophir brochure 247246**, **EntryPoint brochure 1061309**, and the listed **March 2019 Inferent Part 2A** original. Verify version and filing date rather than substituting a nearby amendment. Existing 2018 Inferent and March 2025/2026 EntryPoint originals remain available.

For the EP international feeder, obtain Cayman formation/registered-statement and GP-change originals that resolve the reported LP/Corporation discrepancy. Match the exact fund and identifier; do not infer legal form from a U.S. offering label alone.

**Completion test:** original instrument, relevant entity/version, dated page support. Missing fee calculation language must not be reconstructed from market convention.

## 9. Resolve financial and date discrepancies without silent correction

Obtain an original supporting or corrected Inferent withdrawal balance sheet for **FilingID 1398407** to establish its measurement date and reconcile the **$1** assets-versus-liabilities/equity difference. Keep reported negative equity separate from any legal insolvency conclusion.

Seek an official correction or explanation for EntryPoint **2024 Q3 13F accession 0001992519-24-000008**, whose cover and information table differ, and preserve the separate **2024 Q2 NEW HOLDINGS amendment** treatment. Do not sum amendment snapshots or substitute inferred corrected totals.

For Cboe **12-0099/12-0126**, reconcile the June 26, 2013 FINRA resolution entry with the July 3 original order only through a controlling original record. Preserve both in the meantime.

**Completion test:** source-specific correction or reconciliation with original figures still visible. Keep RAUM, ERA private-fund assets, fund gross assets, Form D cumulative sales and 13F holdings distinct.

## 10. Reconcile the unavailable prior Library research

When access becomes available, review **EntryPoint_Deep_Profile_2026-11-04.docx**, **EntryPoint_Fee_Model_2026-11-04.xlsx**, **Bleich Forensic.rtf**, **Bleich_EntryPoint_Forensic_Due_Diligence_Report.docx**, and the referenced **dossier**.

The user has no local copies and the available Library session did not provide access. No reconciliation has been performed. Treat all prior assertions as leads and map each accepted proposition to a preserved official original; record unsupported statements and citation corrections separately.

**Completion test:** a claim-by-claim crosswalk, not an assumed import of the previous narrative. The excluded legacy repository root materials remain outside the research scope unless the user changes that instruction.

## 11. Repeat independent QA only for changed evidence or conclusions

After new records are obtained, assign a separate reviewer to challenge identity joins, source class, date meaning, financial metric, and firm-versus-person attribution. Rebuild the normalized index, verify foreign keys and all preserved-document hashes, and seal the file manifest. Preserve revisions on the same research branch without merging the default branch.

The present public-source pass and its full-file scans are complete. Further closure requires new records, changed access, or the specific identity and transaction bridges above; repeated identical searches do not satisfy those completion tests.
